trade_interpretation.native_measure: MCS header reports metric tonnes REO equivalent unless otherwise specified; trade footnote says REO equivalent OR content estimated. Do not silently replace that with gross material tonnes or pure elemental tonnes.
trade_interpretation.export_category_mix: Ores and compounds includes upstream concentrates as well as chemical products. The export aggregate is not the compounds-only export term in apparent consumption.
trade_interpretation.codes_note: Codes are the summary tariff context printed by USGS, not a claimed exhaustive trade-query definition. For new Census/Comtrade records preserve the exact current code, description, reporter, partner, gross/net weight and estimate convention.
trade_interpretation.apparent_consumption: USGS defines production + imports − exports for compounds/metals. It is not observed final magnet use and excludes significant embedded rare earths in imported finished goods.
trade_interpretation.heavy_elements: The heavy-REE chapter has no national trade codes for individual heavy materials, estimates aggregate imports from shipping records, and lacks quantitative exports. It cannot supply a Dy/Tb national mass balance.
